'''Biranca Hasad''' was an [[Aes Sedai]]  who lived after the [[Breaking of the World]] and before the founding of the [[White Tower]].{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Biranca Hasad}}

==History==
Circa {{Ab|47}}, Biranca was one of over twelve women who sat for their ''ajahs'' (note the lowercase) in discussion for building a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower}}

It is not clear if Biranca and her group of Aes Sedai refused to participate in the building of [[Tar Valon]] or instead voluntarily joined one of the other seven groups that became the traditional seven Ajah of the White Tower.

In the first case most probably Biranca's group was forced to bow by [[Elisane Tishar]], the first [[Amyrlin Seat]], as in other similar cases.
